name: San Casciano in Val di Pesa (Italy)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Casciano in Val di Pesa (a white castle on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of San Casciano in Val di Pesa, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: San Casciano in Val di Pesa arms — white castle on red, crowned, within branches
